usage_notes: Benchmark historical SMS dataset (5574 records; 4827 ham, 747 spam; UK/Singapore English 2011-2012). Used as baseline textual detection component. IMPORTANT: Normalized label 'spam' -> 'scam' is an operational assumption; commercial spam != scam. Used for initial pipeline testing and pilot selection.

source_name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) / National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
usage_notes: Official Indian cybercrime awareness and reporting portal under Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). Designated exclusively as a KNOWLEDGE BASE & TAXONOMY REFERENCE source for citizen safety guidelines, emerging threat descriptions (digital arrest, courier fraud), and helpline 1930 workflows. NOT training data; no bulk scraping.

source_name: Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) Vulnerability & Threat Notes
usage_notes: National cybersecurity incident response agency under MeitY. Designated as KNOWLEDGE BASE & REFERENCE SOURCE for technical scam advisories (banking Trojan APKs, malicious SMS campaign structures, phishing kit patterns). Contextual evidence only; NOT training data.

source_name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) - 'RBI Kehta Hai' & Financial Fraud Bulletins
usage_notes: Central bank financial education initiatives and 'BE(A)WARE' booklet series covering UPI scams, vishing, fictitious lottery offers, and unauthorized loan apps. Designated as KNOWLEDGE BASE asset for banking fraud taxonomy and official mitigation guidance; NOT training data.

source_name: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) Telecom Commercial Communications Guidelines
usage_notes: Regulatory framework for Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) SMS headers, entity registration, and shortcode governance in India. Designated as an EVALUATION & REFERENCE benchmark for assessing SMS sender authenticity.
